profile_text.body:
Twilio Inc is a public company headquartered in San Francisco, California, trading under the ticker TWLO, with CIK 0001447669. Its site describes a communications platform offering APIs for SMS, RCS, voice, and email, along with conversational AI for customer engagement and identity verification. Twilio describes the platform as connecting communication channels, customer context, and AI in one place, with pay-as-you-go pricing and flexible plans.

The company positions its AI work around agents that handle customer conversations. Per its site, AI agents draw on internal knowledge and real-time data, coordinate across channels, and hand off to human staff when complexity or customer intent calls for it, with context carried through the transfer. Twilio frames this as serving the "agentic era," with humans and AI agents working together on the same platform.

The site's product catalog does not list specific Twilio products, and no lawsuits or MCP servers are recorded. Litigation exposure is listed for California, with a count of 281.
